description: The source lists one general anaesthetic twice under the same identifier, so that the anaesthesia layer writes that identifier twice and the gate on repeated identifiers fails.

expectations.says: The visit detail table holds the anaesthetic twice under one identifier.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_written, COUNT(DISTINCT vd.visit_detail_id) AS identifiers FROM omop.visit_detail vd WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001531'
